svg.text: 04 Guardrails 纵深防御 · Azure（Final v10）
Foundry Guardrails + APIM + Network Isolation + Human Review
控制面不位于每次 Runtime 请求的数据路径中 · approved changes route to the appropriate control
◆ AI Application / Agent Runtime · Runtime / Data Plane
private connection via Private Link / PE
Agent Tool Security Path · Application / Runtime Controls
custom middleware / MCP / network / tool authorization
Approved runtime safety config governs tool-call policy + tool-response sanitization
PII / secret / untrusted data · custom / preview
OpenTelemetry spans · APIM / Guardrails / Agent / Tooling · trace_id / correlation_id
• distributed spans across APIM / Guardrails / Agent / Tooling
• answer: why was a request blocked, rewritten, or escalated?
◆ Exception Handling / Human Review / Safety Feedback
人工审核不会自动修改生产 Policy；必须经过评估与批准流程
Control PR → Policy / IaC / RBAC / network tests
both validations must pass → scoped control update
• APIM 本身不是防绕过边界：必须结合 Private Link / Private Endpoint 与 Foundry backend public access restriction。
• Microsoft Foundry 边界只包含受管能力；Tool policy、MCP、Egress 与 Sanitization 属于应用 / Runtime 安全控制。
